site: ArcelorMittal Cleveland - Vista Pointe Landfill Area C
fatal_reasons: The full vegetated Area C closure cap uses the same 24-inch protective-cover design throughout.
The only thicker areas are roads or drainage-related infrastructure and are radar confounders, not a second same-surface depth condition.
The package states that Area C was the first closure cap constructed at Vista Pointe, so it does not provide an adjacent prior full-scale vegetated cap with a different certified thickness.
